_about: Cards whose near-variant wording (a word that differs from the closest implemented card) was checked against the pinned engine source. Each entry names the primitive and where it is used. Source inspection, not execution: the card's own scenario tests remain the proof. Remove an entry if its implementation shows otherwise. Entries with reviewedLines cover Oracle lines below the 0.88 match score: each names the line verbatim and the primitives; a changed Oracle line no longer matches and returns the card to NEEDS_REVIEW.

Eldrazi Displacer.summary: exile-then-return is Effects.Move(→EXILE) then Effects.Move(→BATTLEFIELD) (upstream Emiel the Blessed); Effects.Move takes a tapped flag (sdk-api.md, card-sdk-language-reference 'tapped = true'); {C} in an activation cost is ordinary mana

Forsaken Monument.summary: AdditionalManaOnSourceTap(sourceFilter, whenProducing = TappedForManaType.COLORLESS) takes any GameObjectFilter, so Permanent.youControl() replaces Ultima's Land.youControl(); colorless filter is GameObjectFilter.Any.withCardPredicate(CardPredicate.IsColorless) (tested custom Skittering Cicada)

Abstruse Archaic.summary: TargetFilter.ActivatedOrTriggeredAbilityOnStack.youControl().abilitySourceMatches(filter) takes any GameObjectFilter (Echo uses Creature; reference lists Artifact too); colorless via CardPredicate.IsColorless; mana abilities are untargetable by construction

Darksteel Monolith.summary: MayCastWithoutPayingManaCost(controllerOnly, spellFilter, oncePerTurn, fromZones) — Warped Space uses oncePerTurn + fromZones={EXILE}; here spellFilter = colorless (CardPredicate.IsColorless), fromZones = {HAND}. Paying {0} rather than the mana cost is the same alternative cost

Ancient Stone Idol.summary: Dies trigger: Triggers.self.dies() + Effects.CreateToken(power=6, toughness=12, creatureTypes={Construct}, keywords={TRAMPLE}, artifactToken=true); same shape as Thopter Mechanic with different stats/keyword

reviewedLines.line: When this creature dies, create a 6/12 colorless Construct artifact creature token with trample.

Marneus Calgar.summary: Activated {6}: Effects.CreateToken(count=2, power=2, toughness=2, colors={WHITE}, creatureTypes={Astartes, Warrior}, keywords={VIGILANCE}); Call the Cavalry's effect as an activated ability

reviewedLines.line: Chapter Master — {6}: Create two 2/2 white Astartes Warrior creature tokens with vigilance.

Thunderhawk Gunship.summary: ETB: Triggers.self.enters() + Effects.CreateToken(count=2, 2/2, WHITE, {Astartes, Warrior}, {VIGILANCE}); Soul of Migration's trigger with Call the Cavalry's token

reviewedLines.line: When this Vehicle enters, create two 2/2 white Astartes Warrior creature tokens with vigilance.

Be'lakor, the Dark Master.summary: Triggers.another(GameObjectFilter.Creature.withSubtype(Demon).youControl()).enters() (Champion of the Path) + Effects.DealDamage(DynamicAmounts.triggeringPower(), target(Targets.Any), damageSource = EffectTarget.TriggeringEntity) (Warstorm Surge)

reviewedLines.line: Lord of Torment — Whenever another Demon you control enters, it deals damage equal to its power to any target.

Kill! Maim! Burn!.summary: Mode: target(Targets.Player) + Effects.DealDamage(3, t); Flame Jet uses Targets.PlayerOrPlaneswalker, Requisition Raid shows Targets.Player; choose-one-or-more modal already matched

reviewedLines.line: • Kill! Maim! Burn! deals 3 damage to target player.

Collective Effort.summary: Mode is Requisition Raid's third mode verbatim: target(Targets.Player) + Effects.ForEachInGroup(GroupFilter(GameObjectFilter.Creature.targetPlayerControls(player)), AddCounters(+1/+1, 1, IterationEntity)); Escalate and the other modes matched

reviewedLines.line: • Put a +1/+1 counter on each creature target player controls.

Mirrorpool.summary: Activated {4}{C}, {T}, sacrifice this land: Effects.CreateTokenCopyOfTarget(target(TargetFilter.CreatureYouControl)) (Self-Reflection), with the same tap+sacrifice-self land cost shape as its matched spell-copy line

reviewedLines.line: {4}{C}, {T}, Sacrifice this land: Create a token that's a copy of target creature you control.

Illuminor Szeras.summary: Mana ability: Costs.Composite(Costs.Tap, Costs.SacrificeAnother(GameObjectFilter.Creature)) (Bolg's Company) + Effects.AddMana(BLACK, DynamicAmounts.manaValueOf(EffectTarget.SacrificedAsCost(0))) (Priest of Yawgmoth). Scenario test must assert X = sacrificed creature's mana value with SacrificeAnother

reviewedLines.line: Secrets of the Soul — {T}, Sacrifice another creature: Add an amount of {B} equal to the sacrificed creature's mana value.
